findings.detail: vitestNamed legs match the bare requirement ID: the NFR-REL-002 leg passes on the rich-text nesting test and ignores FC_RUNS; the NFR-REL-005 leg passes on one schema id test; M2.9-M2.17 acceptance properties have no named leg.
findings.failure_scenario: A 100-case parse fuzz test that ignores FC_RUNS and a schema-only determinism suite turn m2-complete green.

findings.detail: Schemas fill defaults on parse (screen name/kind/size, transform.rot, image/paint fit, document title, comment resolved), so parse(x) is not x and M2.9's byte-equal round trip only holds for inputs that spell out every default.
findings.failure_scenario: A document from an AI patch without screen.kind or transform.rot is rewritten with extra fields on every save.

findings.detail: M2.6 took ADR-0014, which M3.md reserves for command semantics; M2.17 also names ADR-0014.
Checks promised to validate() are not in the M2.10 row: id/key mismatch, exactly one document record, unknown type/kind and rich-text warnings.
findings.failure_scenario: A file with records {a: {id: b}} or two document records validates with no diagnostics.

findings.detail: 02-document-model §1.4 still says TS types are z.infer; §2 puts schemaVersion on the document record while code puts it on DocumentFile; the planned docs-consistency case would not catch either.
findings.failure_scenario: An M3/M14 agent writes z.infer record types or adds document.schemaVersion.

dispositions.note: legs match the plan's exact test titles, FC_RUNS proven by the fuzz test, determinism needs a case per package, named legs for M2.9-M2.17
decide: parsing never fills defaults (ADR-0142); readers apply documented defaults
unplanned ADRs take 0140+ (the harness range after 0139): ADR-0014 of M2.6 becomes ADR-0140, M2.17's dependency ADR is ADR-0141; future plans keep their numbers
row acceptance widened: id/key mismatch, one document record, unknown type/kind and rich-text warnings, each in an invalid fixture
row widened: 02 §1.4 and §2 document row; docs-consistency compares per-record key fields
